component.name: USDX Song Editor
component.summary: Fix UltraStar Deluxe songs without losing information

description.p: A desktop application for editing UltraStar Deluxe song files. It opens a song in the text format that UltraStar Deluxe sings, shows every lyric line with its notes, and lets the editor change pitch, length, type and text with the mouse while listening at the exact spot.

Every repair changes the notes in the song file itself and nothing else: the editor reads and writes the format exactly as the format specification defines it, keeps everything it did not edit byte-identical, and refuses to invent content. Repair timing puts racing lines back on time, the health checks name suspicious and racing lines, and exporting anchors for the USDX Song Factory is an extra on top. The application works standalone, with no Factory, container or network needed.
